title: Ghost and Extraction
author: Yara Nakamura
blurb: Zephyrine Okafor, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
